_comment: Source of truth for the generated reference tables in README.md. Edit here, then run `npm run reference`.

_externalAttributes._comment: Documented attributes that Swiper reads directly, so no Waterfall module references them. Keeps the audit's 'documented but unread' check meaningful.

rows: Unique name for this slider. Marks the element as a Waterfall.
Logs the generated config and initialization details to the console.
Index of the slide to show first.
Set to `true` on a Swiper nested inside another Swiper with the same direction, so touch events are captured correctly.
Number of slides visible at once. Decimals like `1.5` show partial slides; `auto` uses each slide's CSS width.
Number of slides to advance per navigation step.
Number of initial slides that advance one at a time before grouping starts.
With `slidesPerView: auto`, advances by the number of slides currently visible.
Centers the active slide instead of aligning it to the left or top.
Centers the slides when there are fewer than `slidesPerView`.
Normalizes the active slide index when using `slidesPerGroup`.
Resizes the slider height to match the active slide.
Extra space before the first slide.
Extra space after the last slide.
Forces a slider width. Useful only when the slider is hidden on init.
Forces a slider height. Useful only when the slider is hidden on init.
Centers the active slide without leaving gaps at the start and end. Requires `waterfall-centered-slides="true"`; not intended for use with loop or pagination.
Slides visible at this breakpoint, or `auto`.
Slides advanced per step at this breakpoint.
Gap between slides at this breakpoint.
Centers the active slide at this breakpoint.
Measures breakpoints against the window width (default `window`) or the slider container's width.
Wraps around endlessly. Cannot be combined with `waterfall-rewind`; if both are `true`, loop wins and a warning is logged.
Jumps back to the first slide after the last one. Cannot be combined with `waterfall-loop`.
With loop and grid/`slidesPerGroup`, adds blank slides when the slide count isn't evenly divisible.
Extra slides to clone for looping.
Blocks navigation while the loop is repositioning slides.
Swiping in either direction advances to the next slide.
Turns autoplay on. The other autoplay attributes apply only when this is `true`.
Continuous "marquee" scrolling: sets the delay to `0` and applies linear easing to `.swiper-wrapper`. Pair it with a high `waterfall-speed` (e.g. `5000`).
Stops autoplay permanently after the user interacts with the slider.
Pauses while the pointer is over the slider. With `waterfall-smooth-autoplay`, the marquee freezes where it stands and picks the slide back up on the way out.
Stops on the last slide. Has no effect in loop mode.
Waits for the slide transition to finish before the next autoplay step. Turn off when using `waterfall-virtual-translate`.
The play/pause button. On by default whenever autoplay is on and the three `waterfall-el` control elements are present; set to `false` to turn it off.
Whether autoplay starts running or paused on page load.
Set to `false` to turn navigation off even when buttons exist.
Toggles button visibility when the slider is clicked.
Set to `false` to block sliding forward.
Set to `false` to block sliding backward.
Class added to a button when it can't be used (first/last slide).
Class added when navigation is locked (not enough slides).
Class added to the container when navigation is disabled.
Pagination style. `numberBullets` shows bullets containing the slide number.
Set to `false` to turn pagination off even when the element exists.
Clicking a bullet goes to that slide.
Shows only a few bullets at a time; useful with many slides.
Number of main bullets shown with dynamic bullets.
Toggles pagination visibility when the slider is clicked.
Draws the progress bar in the opposite direction to the slider (e.g. vertical on a horizontal slider).
Class added when pagination is clickable.
Class on the current number in `fraction` pagination.
Class on the total number in `fraction` pagination.
Class added when pagination is hidden.
Class added when pagination is locked (not enough slides).
Prefix for the type modifier class (e.g. `swiper-pagination-bullets`).
Class added when pagination is disabled.
Class on the progress bar fill.
Class added with an opposite progress bar.
Class applied to every generated bullet. Overrides the class donated by the `pagination-bullet` element.
Set to `false` to turn the scrollbar off even when the element exists.
Lets the user drag the scrollbar handle.
Hides the scrollbar after the user stops interacting.
Snaps to the nearest slide when the handle is released.
Class added when the scrollbar is locked (not enough slides).
Class added when the scrollbar is disabled.
Class applied to the drag handle. Overrides the class donated by the `scrollbar-drag` element.
How the `fade` effect transitions. `default` fades the outgoing slide over the incoming one, `cross-fade` fades both at once, `out-in` fades out fully before fading in.
Multiplier applied to rotate, depth, and stretch.
Shows the main shadow under the cube.
Limits the rotation of the edge slides.
Slides move freely without snapping to positions.
Snaps to the nearest slide once the momentum ends.
Higher values increase the momentum distance.
Higher values increase the momentum speed.
Bounces at the edges after momentum.
Higher values increase the bounce effect.
Minimum touchmove velocity required to trigger momentum.
Number of slide rows. Works best without loop mode.
Whether slides fill the grid by row or by column.
Name of the thumbnail slider to link.
Offset from the edge at which the thumbnail slider scrolls to keep the active thumb visible.
With multiple slides per view, highlights every thumb that is visible in the main slider.
Class added to the active thumbnail.
Class added to the thumbnail slider container.
Name of the slider to control.
Syncs by slide index (`slide`) or by proportional scroll position (`container`).
Moves the controlled slider in the opposite direction.
Set to `false` to turn off swiping; only navigation and pagination remain.
Lets desktop users drag slides with the mouse.
Slides follow the finger during a swipe. When `false`, they move only on release.
Clicking a slide transitions to it.
Minimum drag distance before a swipe starts.
Maximum angle at which a touch counts as a swipe.
Allows quick, short swipes to change slides.
Allows long swipes to change slides.
Minimum duration for a long swipe.
Fraction of the slide width a long swipe must cover to change slides.
Adds rubber-band resistance at the edges.
Releases touches near the screen edge so the browser's back/forward swipe works.
Width of the edge area used for edge swipe detection.
Element that listens for touch events.
Releases touch events at the slider edges so the page can scroll.
Prevents default on `pointerdown` (blocks text selection while dragging).
Prevents accidental link clicks while swiping.
Stops click events from propagating while swiping.
Blocks interaction while a transition is running.
Turns on swipe blocking for elements matching the no-swiping class or selector.
Swiping is blocked on elements with this class.
Swiping is blocked on elements matching this selector (overrides the class).
`input, select, option, textarea, button, video, label`
Elements that keep native focus behavior instead of starting a swipe.
Restricts swiping to this handle element.
Responds to keys only while the slider is in the viewport.
Page Up / Page Down also navigate.
The mouse wheel controls the slider.
Only responds to wheel movement along the slider's direction.
Lets the page scroll once the slider reaches its first or last slide.
Minimum wheel delta needed to trigger a slide change.
Minimum time between wheel-triggered slide changes.
Element that listens for wheel events.
The mouse wheel is ignored over elements with this class.
Changes slides when the hash changes (e.g. browser back/forward).
Replaces the history entry instead of adding a new one on each change.
URL segment placed before the slide name.
Base URL path for history entries.
Replaces the history entry instead of adding a new one.
Keeps the URL query parameters when the URL is updated.
Never zooms past the image's natural size.
Pans the zoomed image by moving the mouse.
Class of the zoom container element.
Class added to the zoomed slide.

Parallax for elements inside the slider. Left off, it switches itself on only when the slider contains at least one of the `data-swiper-parallax-*` attributes below, so sliders that do not use parallax skip its cost. Set `true` to force it on (needed when the slides only gain those attributes after init), or `false` to force it off.
Horizontal offset for horizontal sliders, vertical offset for vertical ones.
Scale while the slide is out of view.
Opacity while the slide is out of view.
Rotation while the slide is out of view. Applies to elements inside a slide.
Custom transition duration for this element.
Number of slides before and after the active slide whose lazy images load early.
Class of the preloader element that is removed once the image loads.
Turns accessibility features on or off.
ID for the wrapper, used by `aria-controls` on the navigation buttons.
Class of the live-region element used for announcements.
Scrolls to a slide when it receives keyboard focus.
Re-initializes the slider when its style or slides change. Useful for sliders inside tabs or modals.
Also watches parent elements for changes.
Also watches for changes inside slides.
Uses ResizeObserver to detect container size changes.
Recalculates the layout when the window is resized.
Disables the slider and hides navigation when there aren't enough slides to scroll.
Tracks each slide's progress and adds visibility classes. Required on thumbnail sliders.
Set to `false` to create the slider in a disabled state.
Set to `false` to skip automatic initialization; call `swiper.init()` yourself.
Uses native CSS scroll-snap. Many features (effects, loop, some touch options) don't work in CSS mode.
Rounds slide widths and heights to whole pixels to avoid blurry text.
Above this slide count, `backface-visibility: hidden` is not applied (a Safari performance workaround).
Uses passive event listeners where possible.
Looks for navigation elements only inside the slider.
Sets the wrapper's width/height explicitly (for old browsers without flexbox).
Auto-creates navigation/pagination/scrollbar elements. Prefer building them in Webflow instead.
Prefix for DOM events emitted by the slider.
Node name used to detect Swiper Element (web component) containers.
Page URL for server-side rendering with history navigation.
Runs the slider without ever translating the wrapper, for building a custom slide transition.
Calls `window[name]` every time the active slide changes.
Adds this element as the last slide.
Adds this element as the first slide.
Inserts this element at the position given by `waterfall-add-index`.
Removes the slide at `waterfall-remove-index` from the target slider. This element itself is also removed.
Index of the slide to remove.
Optional bullet template. Donates its **tag name** and its **classes** to every generated bullet; `waterfall-pagination-bullet-class` overrides the classes.
Optional drag handle template inside `scrollbar`. Donates its **classes** to the handle Swiper builds; `waterfall-scrollbar-drag-class` overrides them.
Placed inside a slide; its text is replaced with that slide's 1-based number.
Icon shown while autoplay is paused.
Icon shown while autoplay is playing.
